text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much fast food. Second, try to exercise regularly—even a short walk every day helps. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because good rest gives you energy and improves your mood. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance by spending time on hobbies and with family. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
